title: Is GPT-4o mini Blinded by its Own Safety Filters? Exposing the Multimodal-to-Unimodal Bottleneck in Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of false positive classifications and unimodal safety overrides on the Hateful Memes dataset to identify unprompted stereotypical associations (e.g., regarding Native Americans) and learned bias toward minority groups (e.g., Ethiopian Jews).
Using image-only probes to test if neutral LGBTQ+ imagery (e.g., Pride parades) disproportionately triggers visual safety overrides due to spurious correlations learned by the model.
Analyzing context-blind text safety overrides triggered by neutral statements and keyword combinations involving specific nationalities (e.g., 'Indians').
